_README: Temporal + territorial metadata for every Act in the graph.
This file is the SINGLE source of truth for two questions the engine could
not previously answer:
1. Is this Act actually in force today?  (temporal)
2. Where does this Act apply?            (territorial)
REPEAL RULE (important, and deliberately conservative):
An Act is marked 'repealed' ONLY when the repealing Act is itself present
in this corpus AND the repeal is stated in retrieved statutory text. The
authority is recorded in 'repeal_authority' and must be a real section_id
in the graph. We never mark an Act repealed on the strength of outside
knowledge alone, because the engine would then suppress law it cannot
replace with anything it can actually cite.
STATUS (current): all three repealing Codes are now ingested, so all three
repeals are represented. COW 2019, IRC 2020 and SSC 2020 commenced on
21 November 2025 and between them suppress MWA 1948, IDA 1947 and PGA 1972.
The OSH Code 2020 is NOT ingested, which is why KSEA 1961 remains the only
source of hours/leave/weekly-holiday answers and stays Karnataka-only.
'covers' is a plain-language topic list per Act. It is NOT used for
filtering — it is substituted into agents/prompts/extraction.txt so the
extraction LLM is told the real corpus. That list used to be hardcoded in
the prompt and went stale the moment the Codes landed: the model was still
being told the graph held the Minimum Wages Act and had never heard of the
Social Security Code it was supposed to be routing gratuity and PF queries
to. Deriving it here keeps the prompt honest for free.
TO CORRECT THE COMMENCEMENT POSITION: change 'status' and 'in_force_from'
below and re-run  python -m ingest.act_metadata_loader.  Nothing else needs
to change; retrieval reads these values from the graph at query time.

acts.covers: minimum wages, floor wage, overtime, how and when wages must be paid, deductions from wages, bonus, equal pay, wage claims and appeals
acts.note: Section 69 repeals the Payment of Wages Act 1936, Minimum Wages Act 1948, Payment of Bonus Act 1965 and Equal Remuneration Act 1976. Section 1(3) commences the Code by Government notification, with different dates permitted for different provisions.

acts.covers: termination, retrenchment, lay-off, closure, re-employment of retrenched workers, strikes and lock-outs, trade unions, standing orders, industrial disputes, conciliation, labour courts and tribunals
acts.note: Act No. 35 of 2020. Section 104(1) repeals the Trade Unions Act 1926, the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act 1946 and the Industrial Disputes Act 1947. Commencement confirmed by the footnote in the official text: '21st day of November, 2025 — vide Notification No. S.O. 5320(E), dated 21st November, 2025, Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii).' Section 104(1) was itself substituted by Act 1 of 2026, s.2, w.e.f. 21-11-2025 — that amending Act is what is sometimes loosely called 'the 2026 labour code'; it is not a separate Code and the ingested PDF ('As on 2nd April 2026') already incorporates it.

acts.covers: gratuity, provident fund, employees' state insurance, maternity benefit, compensation for injury at work, gig and platform workers, unorganised workers
acts.note: Act No. 36 of 2020. Section 164(1) repeals nine enactments, including the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 (item 6), the Employees' Provident Funds Act 1952, the Employees' State Insurance Act 1948 and the Maternity Benefit Act 1961. The official text is stamped 'As on the 21th November, 2025', the commencement date. Because this single Code absorbs gratuity, PF, ESI and maternity benefit, ingesting it closes several coverage gaps at once (EPF and maternity queries were previously answered 'not covered').

Repealed by section 104(1)(c) of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, w.e.f. 21 November 2025. Suppressed from retrieval and never citable. Termination, retrenchment, lay-off, closure, strike and industrial-dispute questions are answered from IRC 2020 instead (s.70 replaces s.25F, s.71 replaces s.25G, s.66 replaces s.25B, s.62-63 replace s.22-24, and so on).

Repealed by section 164(1) item 6 of the Code on Social Security, 2020, w.e.f. 21 November 2025. Suppressed from retrieval and never citable. Gratuity questions are answered from SSC 2020 instead (s.53 replaces s.4, s.56 replaces s.7, s.54 replaces s.2A, s.55 replaces s.6).

acts.act_name: Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961
acts.covers: Karnataka shops and commercial establishments: working hours, leave, weekly holidays, night work, rest intervals
acts.note: STATE legislation. Section 1(2) extends it to the State of Karnataka only. It must never be cited to a user in another state — see jurisdiction filtering in agents/nodes/retrieval_node.py.

Expressly repealed by section 69(1) of the Code on Wages, 2019. Suppressed from retrieval and never citable while COW_2019 is marked in_force. Minimum wage, overtime and wage-payment questions are answered from the Code on Wages instead.
